rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent when the exact location is unknown, especially after 喺.

example.traditional: 我喺唔知邊度見過呢本書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 m4 zi1 bin1 dou6 gin3 gwo3 ni1 bun2 syu1

rows.traditional: 去 + 個 + A + 嘅地方
rows.jyutping: heoi3 go3 A ge3 dei6 fong1
rows.note: Use this for an unspecified destination described by A, as in going somewhere warm.

example.english: I want to go somewhere warm for a vacation.
example.traditional: 我想去個暖啲嘅地方度假。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 go3 nyun5 di1 ge3 dei6 fong1 dou6 gaa3

rows.traditional: 大概係 A 至 B 之間
rows.jyutping: daai6 koi3 hai6 A zi3 B zi1 gaan1
rows.note: Use this for an approximate point within a numerical range or other stated endpoints.

example.english: This shirt costs somewhere between fifty and sixty dollars.
example.traditional: 呢件衫大概係五十至六十蚊之間。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 daai6 koi3 hai6 ng5 sap6 zi3 luk6 sap6 man1 zi1 gaan1
